pattern: \b(endolysin|lysin|phage lysin|lytic enzyme|peptidoglycan hydrolase|peptidoglycan-degrading enzyme|murein hydrolase|muramidase|lysozyme|N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanine amidase|glycosidase involved in host cell lysis)\b
rationale: Direct or catalytic lytic-enzyme terminology. Free-text Function [CC] is excluded to avoid assigning holins/spanins merely because they mention endolysins.
Depolymerase terminology from protein identity/catalytic evidence; free-text Function [CC] is not used as a primary trigger.

pattern: \b(tailspike|tail spike|tail fiber|tail fibre|receptor[- ]binding protein|baseplate|adsorption protein|host recognition protein)\b
rationale: Tail/adsorption proteins can carry virion-associated lytic or depolymerase activity; do not treat as clean negatives.
Lysis-adjacent phage proteins that are usually not lytic enzymes; retain as hard-negative candidates.

pattern: \b(major capsid protein|minor capsid protein|capsid protein|head protein|head decoration protein|decoration protein)\b
\b(DNA polymerase|RNA polymerase|DNA helicase|helicase|primase|DNA primase|replication protein|DNA-binding protein|single-stranded DNA-binding protein|SSB protein)\b
\b(transcription factor|transcriptional regulator|antitermination protein|anti-termination protein|sigma factor|RNA-binding protein)\b

rationale: Explicit non-lytic catalytic/metabolic functions. Generic protease/peptidase terms are excluded because phage lytic enzymes can themselves be peptidases.

pattern: \b(scaffolding protein|scaffold protein|assembly protein|maturation protein|head completion protein)\b
\b(uncharacterized protein|hypothetical protein|unknown protein|protein of unknown function|function unknown|uncharacterized ORF)\b

rationale: Domain/family assignment without resolved biological function.

pattern: ^(ORF[-_ ]?\d+[A-Za-z]?|open reading frame(?: protein)?|unnamed protein product|predicted protein|putative protein)$
